title: A Time-Frequency-Condition Multimodal Fusion Foundation Model for Universal Rotating-Machinery Fault Diagnosis under Multi-Element Heterogeneous Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2611.15051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intelligent fault diagnosis models are typically developed for a single machine under a specific set of operating conditions, such that each new machine or condition requires retraining from scratch. This one-machine-one-model paradigm scales poorly. Although transfer learning and domain generalization can reduce the labeling burden, they primarily seek domain-invariant commonality, potentially discarding machine-specific characteristics that are critical for diagnosis. This paper proposes TFC-MMFD, a time-frequency-condition multimodal fusion foundation model for rotating-machinery fault diagnosis under multi-element heterogeneous scenarios. translated_title: 一种面向多要素异构场景下通用旋转机械故障诊断的时频-工况多模态融合基础模型
translated_abstract: 智能故障诊断模型通常针对单一机器在特定运行工况下开发，导致每种新机器或新工况都需要从头重新训练，这种“一机一模”范式的可扩展性较差。尽管迁移学习和领域泛化能够减轻标注负担，但它们主要追求领域不变的共性特征，可能会丢弃对诊断至关重要的机器特异性信息。本文提出了TFC-MMFD，一种面向多要素异构场景下旋转机械故障诊断的时频-工况多模态融合基础模型。该方法将统计指标、时频图像、振动序列以及描述机器和工况的文本统一标记化为类语言空间，使不同物理来源的输入能够被表示为单一序列。采用LLaMA骨干网络并结合跨模态双向机制，实现多要素异构场景下的通用故障诊断能力。
tldr: 提出了TFC-MMFD基础模型，将统计指标、时频图像、振动序列和文本描述统一标记化为类语言空间，并利用LLaMA骨干网络实现多要素异构场景下旋转机械的通用故障诊断，突破了传统“一机一模”范式的局限性。
en_tdlr: TFC-MMFD, a time-frequency-condition multimodal fusion foundation model that tokenizes statistical indicators, time-frequency images, vibration sequences, and textual descriptions into a unified language-like space with a LLaMA backbone, enabling universal rotating-machinery fault diagnosis under multi-element heterogeneous scenarios beyond the one-machine-one-model paradigm.
